name: IDGLDD: An Image Dataset of Guava Leaf Diseases and Pest Damage for Five-Class Classification
description: This dataset contains 4,715 guava (Psidium guajava) leaf images in five balanced classes of 943 images each, built for developing and benchmarking computer vision models for automated guava leaf disease and pest-damage detection. The classes are: Anthracnose: fungal disease lesions Caterpillar damage: leaf damage from caterpillar feeding Healthy: leaves with no visible disease or damage Red rust: red-rust affected leaves Spiraling whitefly: infestation by the spiraling whitefly Images were collected from Dhaka, Bangladesh in July-August, 2025 using Samsung Galaxy A55 5G under natural field conditions. They were manually sorted and labeled by an agricultural specialist. Images are in JPG format at 512x512 resolution.
